statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (a : ℝ≥0∞), (∑' j : ℕ, if j < N then a else 0) = (N : ℝ≥0∞) * a
proof:
intro N a
calc
  (∑' j : ℕ, if j < N then a else 0) =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, (if j < N then a else 0) :=
    tsum_eq_sum (fun j hj => if_neg (by simpa using hj))
  _ = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, a :=
    Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j hj => if_pos (Finset.mem_range.mp hj))
  _ = (N : ℝ≥0∞) * a := by simp
